criteria.run: test -f Dockerfile && test -f docker-compose.yml && docker compose config -q

test -f docs/ARCHITECTURE.md && test -f docs/ADDING_A_DOCUMENT_CLASS.md && test -f docs/EXTERNAL_COMPONENTS.md && test -f .github/workflows/ci.yml && test -f start.bat && grep -qi 'recipes/' docs/ADDING_A_DOCUMENT_CLASS.md && grep -qi 'licen' docs/EXTERNAL_COMPONENTS.md

rm -rf .acc/venv && py -3.13 -m venv .acc/venv && .acc/venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pip install -q -r requirements.txt && .acc/venv/Scripts/python.exe -m odw2json --help && .acc/venv/Scripts/python.exe -c 'import web.app'

criteria.text: Judge on a clean checkout: `docker compose up --build` serves the web UI on localhost and `docker compose run --rm cli` (or the documented equivalent) processes ./input into ./output; start.bat does the same on Windows with Python 3.13; README quick start works without reading the code.
